purpose: The single shared answer to 'which coats exist in the live game'. Genetics and rendering both read it. A coat class is playable only when BOTH genetics and visuals have reached the required status. See docs/decisions/D-001-parallel-genetics-and-visuals.md.

statusMeaning.specified: Rules or render approach written down and reviewed.
statusMeaning.prototype: Genetics: implemented with passing exact fixtures. Visuals: renders in-engine in the neutral validation scene, not yet signed off.
statusMeaning.approved: Genetics: reviewed against sources. Visuals: signed off on adult and foal, all LODs, in neutral and stable lighting.
statusMeaning.released: Enabled in the live catalog; founders and NPC stock may carry it.

rules: releaseStatus <= min(geneticStatus, visualStatus). Enforced by tools/validate_handoff.py.

The genetics engine may model alleles for unreleased classes internally (tests, sandbox) but live founder/NPC generation must only produce genotypes whose resolved class is released. Enforced by a reachability test in the domain suite.
The renderer composes LAYERS, not bespoke per-class art. Visual cost grows with layers plus listed interactions, not with the number of genotype combinations.
A genotype resolving to a class with no released render must never reach a live save; the resolver returns an explicit 'unsupported' result rather than a fallback colour.

layers.drives: Eumelanin/pheomelanin per anatomical region (body, points, mane/tail, muzzle)
Both pigments strongly diluted; pink skin; blue eyes
Body hair dilution with darker points
Dorsal stripe, leg barring, shoulder marks (dun and nd1)
Face/leg white in canonical body coordinates from the marking seed (artistic modifier, labelled as such)
Coat dilution plus mottled skin and amber eyes
Versioned age curve of depigmentation over the base result
Intermingled white body hairs, solid head/legs

interactionsNeedingBespokeArt: cream_double changes skin AND eyes, not only hair
grey_age must compose over every other layer and age foal -> adult -> senior
white_tobiano + white_sabino1 + individual_white_markings overlap on the same masks
leopard_complex: PATN1 coverage only expresses with LP
silver only visible where eumelanin exists (masked on chestnut)

coatClasses.note: nd1: faint primitive markings without dilution; applies over any base class
dunalino / dunskin / smoky grullo; first test of layer stacking
overlay family: combines with any released base class
